CEST) to discuss the results PARIS, France – June 29, 2026 – 10:05 pm CEST – Abivax SA (Euronext Paris: FR0012333284 – ABVX / Nasdaq: ABVX) (“Abivax” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing therapeutics that harness the body’s natural regulatory mechanisms to stabilize the immune response in patients with chronic inflammatory diseases, today announced topline results from ABTECT Maintenance Part 2, the supplemental portion of its Phase 3 UC maintenance program evaluating obefazimod, its investigational oral miR-124 enhancer, in adults with moderately to severely active UC.

The additional safety results generated through Part 2 expand the Phase 3 maintenance database and provide important context for interpreting the safety findings reported following the Maintenance Part 1 readout.
